steps.en: Officer can open an upload page instead of searching
steps.id: Officer bisa membuka halaman upload sebagai pengganti pencarian

steps.en: The list is uploaded as a CSV file
steps.why_en: The upload accepts only Excel files; CSV files are refused.
steps.why_id: Upload hanya menerima file Excel; file CSV ditolak.

steps.en: The file is read and its content checked
Each notice number in the file is looked up
steps.id: Setiap nomor notice di file dicari datanya

steps.en: Uploaded notices are shown on screen
steps.id: Notice hasil upload ditampilkan di layar
